globalConstraints: No cat, substitute cat, person, date, postmark, caption, logo, watermark, UI, composition frame, or anchor mark in candidate scene images.
Rare companions appear only in variants explicitly marked hasCompanion=true.
Keep the landmark immediately recognizable and preserve its defining silhouette and proportions.
Reserve an unobstructed, low-detail, low-contrast composition slot away from landmark recognition points and future copy and postmark zones.
Avoid photorealism, 3D, flat vector art, neon, high saturation, hard digital gradients, thick black outlines, crowded backgrounds, malformed architecture, and pseudo-text.

Use thin warm gray-brown linework, low-saturation sage green, ochre, faded vermilion, generous negative space, subtle warm-white paper texture, restrained watercolor bleed, and a quiet nostalgic mood.
